title: SQL query on client 080 succeeds with zero rows (no data-read authorization)
symptom: SAP(action=query) on sap_cloud_dev returns column metadata and "Rows": [] with no error; system INFO fails with 'No authorization to view data' (S_ABPLNGVS).
rootCause: The dev user on GM2/080 has no data-read authorization. Metadata, source, ATC and activation work.

solutions.label: Ask for the evidence
solutions.body: Screenshot from the Fiori app or the functional author.

prevention: Never quote an empty result from 080 as a finding.
